verdict.rationale: Highnote is a GraphQL API platform where individual mutations (issue card, add note, set spend rule) could technically be scripted in a loop to act on many items, and program-level rules apply 'uniformly across every card,' but there is no documented bulk/batch mutation, batch endpoint, or async job API for operating on many items in one call. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints or mutations, evidence of batch job status/async processing, and any documentation or example of multi-item operations beyond single-resource mutations.
